scripts.prep:vendor: cd vendor && rm -rf node_modules && npm_config_arch=arm64 npm_config_target_arch=arm64 npm ci --omit=dev --no-fund --no-audit --silent
scripts.prep:vendor:whisper-cli: cd vendor/node_modules/nodejs-whisper/cpp/whisper.cpp && rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DBUILD_SHARED_LIBS=OFF -DGGML_OPENMP=OFF -DGGML_NATIVE=OFF -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=arm64 > /dev/null && cmake --build build -j --config Release > /dev/null
scripts.verify:arm64: node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process');const targets=['vendor/node_modules/ffmpeg-static/ffmpeg','vendor/node_modules/nodejs-whisper/cpp/whisper.cpp/build/bin/whisper-cli'];for(const t of targets){const info=execSync('file '+t).toString();if(!info.includes('arm64')){console.error('FAIL: '+t+' is not arm64:\n  '+info.trim());process.exit(1)}console.log('OK arm64: '+t)}"
